Proposal 2 is the only survivor, but it is not yet an explicit construction. KILL proposal 3. On the row/column-sum-zero real space, S_q×S_q invariance leaves essentially one quadratic component, so the selector reduces to scaled Frobenius geometry: permutations pay a linear baseline while nearby integral nonpermutations incur only constant excess. This is the existing additive table-norm wall, not an escape from it.

KILL proposal 4. Minors through order three are bounded-degree Boolean signatures and inherit the certified fourth-cube relation; thus the proposed experiment tests an already-obstructed regime. Using enough characteristic coefficients to become genuinely global creates an unproved exponential minor/state expansion, while determinant circuitry re-enters tableau faults.

KILL proposal 5. The quadratic Veronese linearization is directly covered by the degree-two cube obstruction, and Q=0 on every legal permutation means odd XORs of legal lifted witnesses also have zero Q-shell. The semantic orthogonality characterization is correct but does not survive binary linearization.

KILL proposal 6. No explicit polynomial route dictionary, coupled network, or expander-load matrix is given, and atomic route choices still admit arbitrary XOR and rectangle-splice attacks. A charge of O(log q) above a YES baseline O(q log q) is merely additive; recursion has no mixed-word or output-rank theorem.
evidence: The certified obstruction map proves bounded-degree cube relations survive arbitrary linear postprocessing, tensoring, and modular reduction. It also certifies rectangle/tableau kernels and constant-cost exact-fiber repairs under the interfaces used by proposals 4–6.

Existing all-eight and twisted-holonomy diagnostics already produce illegal affine mixed words whose nonlinear walk shells cancel completely. The exchange-quotient verifier also found illegal odd covers in the affine span of legal matchings in 32 instances.

Variable pair-projection CVP was exactly tested at squared distance 12 versus 14, and global binary feature shells achieved at best 7/6. These results support the baseline objection to proposals 3 and 5 but are finite evidence, not asymptotic impossibility beyond the proved invariant-form argument.

Prior dense or structured folds provide no positive precedent: modular-Kronecker, truncated-algebra, and frozen M_3(F_4) folds all lost the gap, with the latter producing best NO distance zero. These failures do not exclude proposal 2's distinct condenser family.

No verifier evidence accompanies any present proposal. Proposal 2 remains worth one test solely because code-dependent dense structured folding is explicitly outside the current tensor no-go, provided every mixed word and exact output rank are checked.
